race.title: PricedUp Bet Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: ST FAZ thrived on the Flat for shrewd connections this year and looks well worth another chance in this sphere. The most solid of the dangers is Tilehurst , who goes well for Sean Bowen, with Ballygeary and Moutarde both potentially interesting if on a going day. ST FAZ (FR) TILEHURST MOUTARDE (IRE)
